schema:name: Community Health Info Service
schema:description:
This component provides the web and mobile interface through which patients and families access health information, services, and engagement tools. It serves as the front-end layer connecting users to the broader patient engagement platform.

The purpose of this component is to deliver an accessible, user-friendly entry point that works across devices and connectivity levels, including low-bandwidth environments. 

Example: A community health worker assists a patient in registering on the mobile health app, which displays the patient's care plan and appointment schedule in a simplified, locally adapted interface.
